summary: The change adds pre-PBKDF2 request throttling to both password login and continuation, applies 15-minute source and account buckets, returns 429 with Retry-After, and includes focused budget, rejection, and isolation tests.

evidence: src/passport.ts:700-702 and 727-729 check allowPasswordAttempt before verifyPassword or hashPassword, enforcing the limits before expensive work.

src/passport.ts:1978-1994 increments a source bucket keyed by client IP and an account bucket keyed by normalized email; src/password.ts:10-12 sets 20-per-source and 5-per-account budgets over 15 minutes.
src/passport.ts:1973-1976 returns a non-enumerating rate_limited response with HTTP 429 and Retry-After: 900.
src/handler_test.ts:2389-2496 covers the allowed budgets, rejection after each budget, retry header, account isolation, source throttling, and confirms rejected attempts do not invoke verification.
